body:
Hi Anna,

Your homepage is a grid of lovely pruning photos, and that is genuinely all it is. There is not a single word on it: no phone number, no word about what fine pruning actually is, no reason for a Decatur homeowner to pick you. Someone has to think to click contact before they learn anything at all.

That is a shame, because a specialist service like yours sells on explanation. Most visitors will not dig. They will land, see pretty branches, and leave without ever learning your name or what you do.

So I redesigned your homepage, and the finished design is attached to this email as a PDF. Your photographs still lead the page, but now they have words with them: what fine pruning is, the services you offer, your training and your ISA Certified Arborist credential up front, and a clear way to get in touch.

I build websites for small service businesses, and yours mostly needs words in the right places: what you prune, why it matters, and how to book you. Two landscaping sites I have done are Texas Landscape (texaslandscape.com) and NH Landscape Garden (nhlandscapegarden.com), both built to turn lookers into calls.

If you like the direction, I can build it into your real homepage and keep your photos exactly where they belong. If not, the PDF is yours to keep either way.

Best,
Hassan
name: Fine Pruning
subject: 🌿 Anna, your homepage has no words on it at all
